verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is an account-based coding-agent service with headless and CI use, so issuing scoped agent credentials is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only magic-link email sign-in, which needs no API key by default, plus sandbox and approval policies. Those are adjacent execution controls, not scoped or least-privilege API credentials. Bring-your-own provider keys are user-supplied third-party keys, not credentials ByteAsk issues.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
